lines.trans: Katya, Eleonora Andreyevna is calling for you.
Listen, I did not think that I would say such a thing.
But thank you for being a blabbermouth.
I did not understand.
I know that you confessed everything.
Katya reacted so calmly.
A huge weight fell right off my shoulders.
Listen, Den, there is one catch.
What are you talking about?
Mom, this is only Denis's and my business.
You had better talk to her yourself.
Alright, we will sort everything out right now.
